fact_check_verdict: The satellite-measured surface motion and photogrammetry comparison are strong. Independent Component Analysis separated two statistical signals that the authors interpret as long-term and seasonal motion. The sunlight, meltwater and deep sliding mechanism remains a model-dependent explanation rather than direct underground proof.

claims.spoken: Near McCarthy, researchers mapped seven active rock glaciers in Wrangell Saint Elias.
requires: Do not call them ordinary glaciers. They are ice-rich mixtures of rock debris and ice.

claims.spoken: The study analyzed Sentinel One radar observations across a period reported as twenty eighteen through twenty twenty-two.
requires: Do not imply every ascending and descending input covers the identical date span.

claims.spoken: Parts of Sourdough Peak moved more than one hundred sixty centimeters a year.
claims.on_screen: >160 CM PER YEAR · SOURDOUGH PEAK CORE
requires: Limit the rate to the high-velocity central trunk, not the entire landform.

claims.spoken: A nearby McCarthy Creek glacier moved at less than half that pace in the university's summary.
claims.on_screen: NEARBY · LESS THAN HALF AS FAST
requires: Attribute the shorthand comparison to the SMU release. The paper reports spatially variable fields and maxima of 61 and 41 centimeters per year for McCarthy lobes.

claims.spoken: The radar result was checked against independent photogrammetry across more than sixteen thousand pixels.
requires: The comparison is specific to Sourdough Peak.

claims.spoken: The two maps correlated at point eight four two, with a mean absolute error of ten point seven two centimeters a year.
requires: Label this as the Sourdough InSAR versus photogrammetry comparison.

claims.spoken: Then an unsupervised signal-separation method split the motion into a long crawl and a seasonal pulse.
requires: Call ICA statistical or unsupervised signal separation. Do not call it generative AI or a predictive model. Researchers fixed the component count at two and interpreted the outputs.

claims.spoken: The seasonal signal peaked twice each year, once after snowmelt and again with later rain.
requires: Say associated with or corresponded with. Do not claim experimental causal proof.

claims.spoken: In four measured years, the first pulse followed snowmelt by seventy-two to eighty-four days.
requires: For 2019, snow-water-equivalent data were missing and the authors estimated 84 to 96 days from a temperature proxy. Do not fold 2019 into the four-year observed range.

claims.spoken: The authors modeled a reason. Sunlight may open a path for water to reach a buried sliding layer.
requires: Keep may and modeled. The radiation and CryoGrid results are not direct subsurface measurements.

claims.spoken: There were no borehole temperatures and the weather station sat six kilometers away.
claims.on_screen: NO BOREHOLE TEMPERATURES · SNOTEL 6 KM AWAY
requires: Do not imply the surface-motion measurements are therefore untrustworthy. This limits the modeled mechanism.

claims.spoken: Two of the smaller glaciers did not follow the simple sunlight pattern.
requires: RG5 includes atmospheric artifacts. The paper says a larger sample is needed before broad conclusions.

claims.spoken: The researchers fixed the separation at two components, then interpreted the outputs.
claims.on_screen: 2 COMPONENTS · FIXED BY RESEARCHERS · OUTPUTS INTERPRETED
requires: Make the researcher choice explicit. Do not imply the method discovered the number of components or named their physical meaning on its own.

claims.spoken: For twenty nineteen, missing snow data required an estimated lag of eighty-four to ninety-six days from a temperature proxy.
requires: Keep 2019 separate from the four measured years and label its lag estimated rather than observed.
